comparison: Keep ordinary strict host check and its expected different-thread/init failure. Separate study requires all other identity/endpoint/log checks and every saved binary64 value exact; only a single num_threads initialization line may differ. No interpolation/tolerance relaxation.
adoption: Use only completed, exactly equivalent runs to choose a future throughput setting. Do not stop or restart existing long runs solely to apply a faster setting. No global PVT, MC or circuit qualification.
